![](Images/banner_health_analytics.png){fig-align="center" width="100%"} ### Module 02 — Geospatial Health Disparities Map # Geospatial Health Disparities Map *** **Learning objectives** - Join patient ZIP codes to census tracts using synthetic spatial data - Compute age-adjusted hospitalisation rates and readmission rates by area - Create choropleth maps with `sf` and ggplot2 - Overlay a social vulnerability index (SVI) and compute spatial correlations - Export interactive maps with `leaflet` **Estimated time:** 3 hours | **Level:** Advanced | **Libraries:** `dplyr` / tibble, sf, ggplot2, leaflet, `stats` ## 1. Setup & Dependency Check ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) library(ggplot2) library(patchwork) library(sf) library(leaflet) library(scales) mod02_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod02") dir.create(mod02_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE) theme_health <- function(base_size = 12) { theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) + theme( panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA) ) } theme_set(theme_health()) cat(sprintf("sf %s available.\n", as.character(packageVersion("sf")))) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` sf 1.1.2 available. ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat(sprintf("leaflet %s available.\n", as.character(packageVersion("leaflet")))) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` leaflet 2.2.3 available. ``` ::: ::: ## 2. Synthetic Geospatial Dataset — 50 ZIP Code Areas ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(42) # ── Simulate 50 ZIP code areas (modelled on a mid-size US metropolitan area) ── N_ZIPS <- 50 # Geographic centroids (roughly spanning a metro area, lat/lon) lat_center <- 43.0 lon_center <- -76.1 # ~ Upstate NY zip_df <- tibble( zip = sprintf("%05d", 10000 + seq_len(N_ZIPS) - 1), tract_name = sprintf("Tract %d", 100 + seq_len(N_ZIPS) - 1), lat = runif(N_ZIPS, lat_center - 0.5, lat_center + 0.5), lon = runif(N_ZIPS, lon_center - 0.5, lon_center + 0.5), population = sample(3000:25000, N_ZIPS, replace = TRUE), pct_poverty = rbeta(N_ZIPS, 2, 8) * 50, # 0-50% pct_uninsured = rbeta(N_ZIPS, 1.5, 8) * 30, median_income = pmin(pmax(rnorm(N_ZIPS, 52000, 18000), 15000), 120000), svi_score = rbeta(N_ZIPS, 2, 3), # CDC SVI 0–1, higher=worse pct_elderly = rbeta(N_ZIPS, 2, 6) * 40, # % aged 65+ urban_rural = sample(c("Urban", "Suburban", "Rural"), N_ZIPS, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.50, 0.35, 0.15)) ) # Hospitalisations inversely correlated with income and SVI zip_df$hosp_rate <- pmin(pmax( 200 + zip_df$svi_score * 180 - zip_df$median_income / 1000 * 1.5 + zip_df$pct_elderly * 4.5 + rnorm(N_ZIPS, 0, 25), 50), 600) # Readmission rate zip_df$readmit_rate <- pmin(pmax( 12 + zip_df$svi_score * 10 + zip_df$pct_poverty * 0.18 + rnorm(N_ZIPS, 0, 1.5), 5), 35) # Age-adjusted rate (add noise to crude to simulate adjustment) zip_df$hosp_rate_adj <- pmin(pmax( zip_df$hosp_rate - zip_df$pct_elderly * 3.2 + rnorm(N_ZIPS, 0, 15), 50), 600) cat(sprintf("ZIP code dataset: %d x %d\n", nrow(zip_df), ncol(zip_df))) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ZIP code dataset: 50 x 14 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} print(head(zip_df)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 6 × 14 zip tract_name lat lon population pct_poverty pct_uninsured 1 10000 Tract 100 43.4 -76.3 11273 4.66 0.661 2 10001 Tract 101 43.4 -76.3 17231 8.39 1.70 3 10002 Tract 102 42.8 -76.2 17192 9.63 0.322 4 10003 Tract 103 43.3 -75.8 18719 3.80 0.451 5 10004 Tract 104 43.1 -76.6 18286 11.9 8.35 6 10005 Tract 105 43.0 -75.9 5343 21.5 3.56 # ℹ 7 more variables: median_income , svi_score , pct_elderly , # urban_rural , hosp_rate , readmit_rate , hosp_rate_adj ``` ::: ::: ## 3. Patient-to-ZIP Assignment & Aggregation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # ── Generate patient discharge records with ZIP codes ───────────────────────── set.seed(99) N <- 800 # Assign patients to ZIPs weighted by population zip_weights <- zip_df$population / sum(zip_df$population) patient_zips <- sample(zip_df$zip, size = N, replace = TRUE, prob = zip_weights) patients <- tibble( patient_id = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)), zip = patient_zips, age = as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 62, 16), 18), 95)), sex = sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52)), los_days = as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30)), readmitted_30 = rbinom(N, 1, 0.14), total_charge = round(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30) * 2500, 2) ) # Aggregate to ZIP level zip_agg <- patients %>% group_by(zip) %>% summarise( n_discharges = n(), n_readmitted = sum(readmitted_30), mean_los = mean(los_days), mean_charge = mean(total_charge), .groups = "drop" ) %>% mutate(observed_readmit_rate = n_readmitted / n_discharges * 100) # Merge with ZIP reference table zip_merged <- zip_df %>% left_join(zip_agg, by = "zip") %>% mutate( n_discharges = replace_na(n_discharges, 0), n_readmitted = replace_na(n_readmitted, 0) ) cat(sprintf("Merged ZIP dataset: %d x %d\n", nrow(zip_merged), ncol(zip_merged))) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Merged ZIP dataset: 50 x 19 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat(sprintf("ZIPs with ≥5 discharges: %d\n", sum(zip_merged$n_discharges >= 5))) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ZIPs with ≥5 discharges: 46 ``` ::: ::: ## 4. Scatter-Map Choropleth (sf + ggplot2) ``{r, fig.width=22, fig.height=15} zip_sf <- st_as_sf(zip_merged, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) p_hosp <- ggplot(zip_sf) + geom_sf(aes(colour = hosp_rate_adj, size = population), alpha = 0.8) + scale_colour_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1, name = "hosp rate adj") + scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), name = "Population") + labs(title = "Age-adjusted hospitalisation rate (per 100,000 population)", x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") + theme_health() + theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F4F8", colour = NA)) p_read <- ggplot(zip_sf) + geom_sf(aes(colour = readmit_rate, size = population), alpha = 0.8) + scale_colour_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, name = "readmit rate") + scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), name = "Population") + labs(title = "30-day readmission rate (%)", x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") + theme_health() + theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F4F8", colour = NA)) p_geo <- p_hosp + p_read + plot_annotation(title = "Geographic distribution of health outcomes") print(p_geo) ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "geo_scatter_maps.png"), p_geo, width = 16, height = 6, dpi = 300) ``` ## 5. SVI Correlation Analysis ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # ── Pearson and Spearman correlations with SVI ──────────────────────────────── outcomes <- c("hosp_rate_adj", "readmit_rate", "mean_los", "mean_charge") outcome_labels <- c("Adj. hosp. rate", "Readmit. rate (%)", "Mean LOS", "Mean charge ($)") cat(sprintf("%-20s %10s %7s %10s %7s\n", "Outcome", "Pearson r", "p", "Spearman ρ", "p")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Outcome Pearson r p Spearman ρ p ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat(strrep("-", 65), "\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ----------------------------------------------------------------- ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} for (i in seq_along(outcomes)) { col <- outcomes[i] sub <- zip_merged %>% select(svi_score, all_of(col)) %>% drop_na() pr <- cor.test(sub$svi_score, sub[[col]], method = "pearson") sr <- cor.test(sub$svi_score, sub[[col]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE) cat(sprintf("%-20s %+10.3f %7.4f %+10.3f %7.4f\n", outcome_labels[i], unname(pr$estimate), pr$p.value, unname(sr$estimate), sr$p.value)) } ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Adj. hosp. rate +0.666 0.0000 +0.614 0.0000 Readmit. rate (%) +0.682 0.0000 +0.610 0.0000 Mean LOS +0.002 0.9871 -0.185 0.1994 Mean charge ($) -0.114 0.4286 -0.117 0.4199 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # ── Scatter plots: SVI vs health outcomes ──────────────────────────────────── color_urban <- c(Urban = "#2563EB", Suburban = "#16A34A", Rural = "#DC2626") plot_svi <- function(metric, ylabel) { fit <- lm(zip_merged[[metric]] ~ zip_merged$svi_score) r <- cor.test(zip_merged$svi_score, zip_merged[[metric]], use = "complete.obs") ggplot(zip_merged, aes(x = svi_score, y = .data[[metric]], colour = urban_rural, size = population)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.7) + geom_abline(intercept = coef(fit)[1], slope = coef(fit)[2], colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) + annotate("label", x = 0.04, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, label = sprintf("r = %.2f, p = %.3f", unname(r$estimate), r$p.value), size = 3.3, fill = "white", label.size = 0) + scale_colour_manual(values = color_urban, name = "Area type") + scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 9), guide = "none") + labs(x = "Social Vulnerability Index (SVI)", y = ylabel, title = paste(ylabel, "vs SVI")) + theme_health() } p_svi <- plot_svi("hosp_rate_adj", "Age-adjusted hospitalisation rate") + plot_svi("readmit_rate", "30-day readmission rate (%)") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning in annotate("label", x = 0.04, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, : Ignoring unknown parameters: `label.size` Ignoring unknown parameters: `label.size` ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} print(p_svi) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](MOD02_NB07_Geospatial_Disparities_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "svi_scatter.png"), p_svi, width = 13, height = 5, dpi = 300) ``` ::: ## 6. Quintile Disparity Analysis ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Stratify ZIP codes into SVI quintiles and compare outcomes zip_merged <- zip_merged %>% mutate(svi_quintile = cut( svi_score, breaks = quantile(svi_score, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE), labels = c("Q1 (Least)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5 (Most)"), include.lowest = TRUE )) disparity_table <- zip_merged %>% group_by(svi_quintile) %>% summarise( n_zips = n(), mean_population = mean(population), hosp_rate = mean(hosp_rate_adj), readmit_rate = mean(readmit_rate), pct_uninsured = mean(pct_uninsured), median_income = mean(median_income), .groups = "drop" ) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1))) cat("Health outcomes by SVI quintile:\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Health outcomes by SVI quintile: ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} print(disparity_table) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 5 × 7 svi_quintile n_zips mean_population hosp_rate readmit_rate pct_uninsured 1 Q1 (Least) 10 15326. 147. 15.6 3.1 2 Q2 10 10726. 169. 15.5 3.3 3 Q3 10 13818. 199. 17.6 3.9 4 Q4 10 15061. 226. 17.3 3.6 5 Q5 (Most) 10 15146. 235. 20.2 3.9 # ℹ 1 more variable: median_income ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ratio <- disparity_table$hosp_rate[nrow(disparity_table)] / disparity_table$hosp_rate[1] cat(sprintf("\nDisparity ratio (Q5 vs Q1) for hospitalisation rate: %.2f×\n", ratio)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Disparity ratio (Q5 vs Q1) for hospitalisation rate: 1.60× ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Bar chart of outcomes by SVI quintile colors_q <- c("#2166ac", "#74add1", "#fee090", "#f46d43", "#a50026") plot_q <- function(metric, ylabel) { ggplot(disparity_table, aes(x = svi_quintile, y = .data[[metric]], fill = svi_quintile)) + geom_col(colour = "white", show.legend = FALSE) + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f", .data[[metric]])), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.2) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_q) + labs(x = "SVI quintile", y = ylabel, title = paste(ylabel, "by SVI quintile")) + theme_health() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1)) } p_q <- plot_q("hosp_rate", "Adj. hosp. rate per 100k") + plot_q("readmit_rate", "Readmission rate (%)") + plot_annotation(title = "Health disparities across social vulnerability quintiles") print(p_q) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](MOD02_NB07_Geospatial_Disparities_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "svi_quintile_bar.png"), p_q, width = 13, height = 5, dpi = 300) ``` ::: ## 7. Leaflet Interactive Map ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pal <- colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = zip_merged$hosp_rate_adj) m <- leaflet(zip_merged) %>% addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>% setView(lng = lon_center, lat = lat_center, zoom = 10) %>% addCircleMarkers( lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, radius = ~pmax(4, n_discharges / 5), color = "white", weight = 0.5, fillColor = ~pal(hosp_rate_adj), fillOpacity = 0.8, popup = ~paste0( "ZIP ", zip, "
", "Hosp rate: ", round(hosp_rate_adj), "
", "Readmit: ", sprintf("%.1f", readmit_rate), "%
", "SVI: ", sprintf("%.2f", svi_score), "
", "Discharges: ", as.integer(n_discharges) ) ) %>% addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~hosp_rate_adj, title = "Adj. hosp. rate") htmlwidgets::saveWidget(m, file.path(mod02_dir, "health_disparities_map.html"), selfcontained = TRUE) cat("Interactive map saved:", file.path(mod02_dir, "health_disparities_map.html"), "\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Interactive map saved: /tmp/RtmpvjQ6iO/mod02/health_disparities_map.html ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat("Open in browser to explore — hover over circles for ZIP-level details.\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Open in browser to explore — hover over circles for ZIP-level details. ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} m ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## 8. Knowledge Check 1. Why do we use age-adjusted rates rather than crude rates when comparing hospitalisation across ZIP codes? 2. The SVI-hospitalisation Pearson r = +0.58. What does this tell you? What doesn't it tell you? 3. Why might rural areas show lower hospitalisation rates despite worse health outcomes (hint: access to care)? 4. What additional data source would you add to strengthen this analysis? 5. Re-run the disparity analysis stratified by urban/rural. Does the SVI gradient hold within each stratum? ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Exercise 5 — SVI quintile disparity by urban/rural for (urb in c("Urban", "Suburban", "Rural")) { sub <- zip_merged %>% filter(urban_rural == urb) if (nrow(sub) < 5) next nq <- min(5, max(2, floor(nrow(sub) / 2))) sub <- sub %>% mutate(q = ntile(svi_score, nq)) tbl <- sub %>% group_by(q) %>% summarise( hosp_rate_adj = round(mean(hosp_rate_adj), 1), readmit_rate = round(mean(readmit_rate), 1), .groups = "drop" ) cat(sprintf("\n%s — outcomes by SVI quintile:\n", urb)) print(tbl) } ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Urban — outcomes by SVI quintile: # A tibble: 5 × 3 q hosp_rate_adj readmit_rate 1 1 175. 15.3 2 2 174. 15.6 3 3 211. 17.4 4 4 194. 18.3 5 5 237. 21.6 Suburban — outcomes by SVI quintile: # A tibble: 5 × 3 q hosp_rate_adj readmit_rate 1 1 187. 14.3 2 2 182 18.3 3 3 232. 15.9 4 4 227. 18.3 5 5 204. 20.4 Rural — outcomes by SVI quintile: # A tibble: 5 × 3 q hosp_rate_adj readmit_rate 1 1 95.3 15.2 2 2 159. 16.9 3 3 169 17 4 4 234. 16.6 5 5 273. 19.8 ``` ::: ::: *** **Next → NB-08: Capstone EDA — 30-Day Readmission**
